scripts.dev:db: docker start posthive-pg || docker run -d --name posthive-pg -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -p 5432:5432 postgres:15
scripts.dev:redis: docker start posthive-redis || docker run -d --name posthive-redis -p 127.0.0.1:6379:6379 redis:7-alpine
scripts.dev: pnpm dev:infra && pnpm --parallel --filter api --filter web dev
scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
